per_depth.shortcut_name: Three-material certificate is exactly a triangle
per_depth.common_affordance: The two-unit impossibility condition for exactly three materials is equivalent to finding a triangle (three pairwise volatile materials).
The certificate condition is exactly the existence of a three-vertex clique (triangle) in the undirected volatile-pair graph.
The impossibility condition for exactly three materials under a two-unit conflict-free assignment is exactly a triangle (K3) in the conflict graph.

per_depth.shortcut_name: Recognizing the certificate as a triangle
per_depth.common_affordance: The condition that every pair among the three materials must be mutually volatile, equivalently that the input graph contains a triangle.
For three materials, a two-container partition with no volatile pair inside a container is exactly a proper 2-coloring; it is impossible precisely when the three materials form a triangle.
